Requirement: User can select Email or Social Media as the source channel.
Acceptance Criterion: Source control is visible and accepted by /detect.

Requirement: User can submit message text for analysis.
Acceptance Criterion: Valid text is accepted up to 8,000 characters.

Requirement: System securely normalises text and tokenises URLs, emails, currency and numbers.
Acceptance Criterion: Preprocessing test passes and content is never executed.

Requirement: System transforms text using the deployed vectorizer and machine-learning pipeline.
Acceptance Criterion: Loaded model returns a class for valid text.

Requirement: System classifies each message as Spam or Not Spam.
Acceptance Criterion: Result page displays exactly one class.

Requirement: System displays confidence, spam probability and a risk level.
Acceptance Criterion: Result includes numeric scores and Low/Medium/High risk.

Requirement: System displays positive spam-indicative model signal terms where available.
Acceptance Criterion: Result includes model-derived signals without claiming causal certainty.

Requirement: System stores UI/API predictions in SQLite history.
Acceptance Criterion: Successful prediction creates a history record.

Requirement: User can search/filter prediction history by text, result and source.
Acceptance Criterion: History filters return matching rows.

Requirement: System displays live graphical analytics and evaluation charts.
Acceptance Criterion: Analytics page loads Matplotlib SVG charts rendered from current evaluation/SQLite data.

Requirement: Training workflow compares Bag of Words and TF-IDF across four classifiers.
Acceptance Criterion: evaluation.json contains eight comparable pipelines.

Requirement: External systems can request a JSON prediction through /api/predict.
Acceptance Criterion: Valid JSON returns HTTP 200 and prediction payload.

Requirement: External monitoring can check model availability through /api/health.
Acceptance Criterion: Health endpoint returns model_loaded=true.

Requirement: Project team can download the configured real public datasets and retrain all eight model pipelines.
Acceptance Criterion: fetch_real_data.py builds the combined Email/Social dataset and train.py regenerates current evaluation artifacts.

Requirement: User can activate any of the eight evaluated pipelines for live inference.
Acceptance Criterion: Model Lab activation updates metadata and subsequent predictions/charts use the selected model.

Requirement: Submitted content must be treated as inert text and must never be executed or followed.
Acceptance Criterion: No code path opens URLs or evaluates message content.

Requirement: HTML output must be escaped and security response headers must be present.
Acceptance Criterion: Security header test passes and user text is escaped.

Requirement: Prototype binds to localhost by default and stores prediction history locally.
Acceptance Criterion: Default host is 127.0.0.1 and SQLite is local.

Requirement: Normal single-message inference target is less than 2 seconds on the project development machine.
Acceptance Criterion: Measured processing_ms remains below agreed threshold in acceptance testing.

Requirement: Invalid, empty or oversized input must fail safely with a clear error.
Acceptance Criterion: Validation tests pass without application crash.

Requirement: UI must be responsive and understandable on desktop and mobile-width screens.
Acceptance Criterion: Manual acceptance test on at least two viewport sizes.

Requirement: Code must be modular with separate preprocessing, model, database, security, views and server modules.
Acceptance Criterion: Repository structure follows documented modules.

Requirement: Training metadata must record model version, dataset fingerprint, source/channel class counts and active/best model metrics.
Acceptance Criterion: metadata.json contains all traceability fields.

Requirement: Model comparison must use a fixed random state and consistent split.
Acceptance Criterion: metadata records random_state=42 and common split logic is used.
